params.caption: 🏆 Spirit suffer their first-ever 13-0 map loss in CS2, still beat FUT 2-1 Team Spirit were blanked 13-0 on a map for the first time in the CS2 era, the first such defeat of donk's CS2 career, with coolio on the winning side. Spirit bounced back to take the series 2-1 against a FUT side playing without Krabeni. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 12:27 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: HLTV #CS2 #Esports #GamingNews
